'''NEK-072''', originally known as '''R-DPO''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was reprogrammed by the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[NEK-01]] with a version of NEK-01's personality. After a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was placed on the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Deggar Feps]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Sonnos]], NEK-01 began tracking the Human and learned that Feps planned to travel to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Lost Lady]]''. NEK-072 was sent to board the ''Lost Lady'' and activate a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] calling for nearby [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to destroy the ship.
